summary: All gates green: 645 Rust tests + 200 vitest pass; clippy + fmt + actionlint clean (3 pre-existing actionlint warnings, baseline confirmed in T8 round 2). Smoke verification against fresh release binary in tempdir HOME confirms anonymous discovery (initialize/tools/prompts/resources), enriched tool descriptions, local sign offline (zero non-loopback TCP via lsof inspection on live process), AC14 visibility rejection on local, install idempotence (byte-identical re-run), non-destructive merge (unrelated entries preserved), --check dry-run mtime stability, doctor 6-check structured output with proper exit 1 on fail. AC11 (OAuth-loopback browser flow) and AC15 stderr mismatch warning explicitly deferred to T14 post-deploy (per T11 TR11-6 + audit consensus that binary-embedded discovery makes mismatch unobservable for v1). AC3 macOS netns-equivalent airplane test done via lsof connection inspection (T11 TR11-1 compensation). No blockers; cleared for Task 13 deploy.

gates.details: 645 passed, 0 failed, 4 ignored across 41 test binaries. Identical totals to T11 audit (645/0/4).

gates.details: 143/145 pass + 2 skipped, 18 files. No regression from T6.

gates.name: actionlint .github/workflows/release.yml
gates.details: 3 warnings — all pre-existing on lines 68, 91, 105 in build-linux/build-macos jobs (confirmed in T8 round 2). Zero new findings from this feature.

gates.name: release binary smoke — initialize/tools/list/prompts/list/resources/list (STORAGE_MODE=local, PAYMENT_MODE=none, tempdir HOME)
gates.details: initialize returned protocolVersion 2025-06-18, capabilities {tools,prompts,resources}, embedder {model_id=all-MiniLM-L6-v2, model_version=0.1.0-fastembed-5.13.2, dim=384}. tools/list returned 7 tools, each tool description contains Purpose:+Trigger: sections projected from skill manifests at build time. prompts/list returned 7 prompts. resources/list returned 7 resources (mnemonik://skills/*.md URIs).

gates.name: release binary smoke — sign_memory mode=local + recall + visibility=public rejection
gates.details: mode=local sign succeeded with write_mode=local, visibility=private, synthetic local:* tx IDs, content_hash recorded, COSE_Sign1 signed. Anonymous recall (no JWT) returned total_attestations=1, results=[] — privacy filter correctly excluded the private row (AC13 working). sign_memory {mode=local, visibility=public} rejected with -32602 InvalidParams field=visibility received=public (AC14 working).

gates.name: release binary smoke — airplane-mode local sign (AC3 lsof inspection)
gates.details: Spawned mcp-stdio with mode=local sign in background, watched `lsof -p <pid> -i -n` during sign: zero TCP/UDP connections on the binary process (only PIPE/unix sockets for its own stdin/stdout). Compensates T11 TR11-1 (Linux netns missing on macOS). Sign returned successfully with write_mode=local.

gates.name: shim smoke — install --check (dry-run mtime stability)
gates.details: Created tempdir HOME with pre-existing ~/.claude.json (foo mcpServer) + ~/.cursor/mcp.json (empty). Captured mtime before+after install --check: both unchanged. Output planned: 'would set mcpServers.mnemonik' for both detected files.

gates.name: shim smoke — install (apply, non-destructive, idempotent)
gates.details: install added mcpServers.mnemonik with absolute binary path + args=['mcp-stdio'] (no npx) to ~/.claude.json and ~/.cursor/mcp.json. The pre-existing foo entry preserved byte-identical. Claude Desktop config (~/Library/Application Support/...) silently skipped (file absent). Re-run produced byte-identical SHA256 on both files (idempotence). Output's final line == 'If any of these agents is already running, please restart them.' (exact AC9 string).

gates.name: shim smoke — doctor 6-check structured output + exit 1 on fail
gates.details: Six checks emitted: host-config-entry-presence (pass; 2/3 hosts configured), mcp-mnemonik-xyz-health (pass; 200 OK live), binary-integrity (fail; cached binary absent + repair hint), local-sqlite-rw (pass), identity-accessible (fail; no identity file + repair hint), token-file-integrity (pass; no cached token). Exit code: 1 (correctly non-zero when any check fails). AC17 verified.
